The Cloud Foundry environment is the **open PaaS application runtime** of SAP BTP. It hosts poly‑glot, micro‑service‑oriented business applications and services, provides a wide set of buildpacks, standard Cloud Foundry tools for lifecycle management (start, stop, scale, configure), and integrates SAP‑provided services (messaging, persistence, security, elastic‑scale, HA) [DOC002](https://help.sap.com/docs/btp/sap-business-technology-platform/development-in-cloud-foundry-environment).  

Compared with the other SAP BTP environments:

* **ABAP Environment** – focused on creating extensions for ABAP‑based products (e.g., S/4HANA Cloud) and on migrating existing ABAP code to the cloud [DOC018](https://help.sap.com/docs/BTP/df50977d8bfa4c9a8a063ddb37113c43/38ecf59cdda64150a102cfaa62d5faab.html).  
* **Kyma Environment** – provides a fully managed, cloud‑native **Kubernetes** runtime for container‑based applications [DOC018](https://help.sap.com/docs/BTP/df50977d8bfa4c9a8a063ddb37113c43/38ecf59cdda64150a102cfaa62d5faab.html).  

**Inference:** Thus, Cloud Foundry serves as the general‑purpose, multi‑language PaaS runtime, while ABAP and Kyma target specific technology stacks (ABAP extensions and Kubernetes‑native workloads, respectively).

3. **Select the tooling** –
